lead.hed: USNI: Polar Sentinel steel is up at Bollinger. That is not a delivered cutter.
lead.insight: USNI, Monday from Pascagoula: the first Polar Security Cutter hull is taking shape at Bollinger Mississippi after years of delay. Stern sections of the future USCGC Polar Sentinel (WMSP-21) stand nearly four stories. Modules photographed Aug. 5. Steel in the yard is not ice on the bow.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Coast Guard Acquisition Directorate (CG-9) official class rendering · PUBLIC DOMAIN · sourced via Wikimedia Commons from dcms.uscg.mil PSC_computer_render_750px.jpg
lead.image_note: Official USCG Polar Security Cutter / Polar Sentinel class rendering. Not the Aug. 5 Bollinger yard still (USNI copyright). Not a 2023 prototype-module photo. Not a brand tile. Caption must say official rendering, not delivered cutter.

political.hed: WORLD: Trump defends the Korea-drill cut. The 11-day exercise still started.
political.insight: WORLD Radio, Tuesday: Trump told reporters Monday the Ulchi Freedom Shield cut makes the peninsula safer and cited cost plus Kim. About 18,000 South Korean troops are already in the field. A White House defense is not a changed ops plan. Pin Seoul’s JCS, not the quote.

political.hed: Defense News: U.S.–Ukraine intel sharing is back. That is not a weapons line.
political.insight: Defense News from Kyiv, Monday: Sen. Warner says the intel partnership is strong again after the Feb. 2025 cutoff. Cornyn: “Everybody loves a winner.” Targeting help is not a new interceptor factory. Separate the intel flow from the Patriot-license watch.

political.hed: Law & Liberty: Europe is building a door, not just an age check
political.insight: Law & Liberty, Monday: the Commission’s age-verification mini-wallet is privacy-preserving on its own terms — and sits on the same spec as the mandatory 2026 EU identity wallet. The essay’s point is capacity, not one app. A credential habit is the file, not the child-safety caption.

tech.hed: Helsing put Rakuten on a Japan army drone deal. Tests run through September.
tech.insight: Defense News / Reuters, Monday: Japan’s Ground Self-Defense Force is testing Helsing’s HX-2 strike drone through the end of September. Rakuten says it is brokering the sale. An initial agreement plus a field test is not a signed buy. Brokerage is not inventory.

tech.hed: Air Force wants target drones that can mimic stealth jets
tech.insight: Defense News: an Air Force RFI seeks attritable targets that can play stealth fighters, bombers, and hobby swarms. SAM.gov deadline Sept. 28. QF-16s are not fifth-gen stand-ins. A request for ideas is not a buy.

tech.hed: Anthropic: Claude text will carry a SynthID-style watermark
tech.insight: Anthropic says future Claude models will watermark generated text to meet the EU AI Act. Method is a SynthID-Text approach; they say it does not change readable quality and cannot be traced to a person or chat. Policy mark, not a home detector.

watch.hed: WATCH: Benfold left Yokosuka. The power-loss file is not closed.
watch.insight: USNI Monday: USS Benfold (DDG-65) departed Yokosuka after a scheduled call. She had been towed to Subic after four days without power in the South China Sea. Underway again is not a closed engineering report. Pin the casualty, not the pier photo.

watch.hed: WATCH: Patriot makers still hedge on the Ukraine production license
watch.insight: Defense News from Kyiv: Trump pledged a Patriot-interceptor license last month; Lockheed and Raytheon are talking about what is feasible. Promise is not a factory. Pin until a signed license or a first kit exists.
